lines.zh: 日头一照，我的刺就发懒。
lines.en: Sunlight makes my stinger sluggish.
Click by click, I lost the count again.

lines.zh: 我踩过菌毯，一点声都没有。
lines.en: I cross sculk without a sound.

lines.zh: 从菌毯下走，土腥味最亲。
lines.en: Under the sculk mat, the soil smells like home.

lines.zh: 我只有五点生命，手也抬不动。
lines.en: Five health, and my arm won't lift.

lines.zh: 风穿过肋缝，什么也没带走。
lines.en: Wind through my ribs takes nothing with it.

lines.zh: 尾刺朝着祭坛的方向，偏了。
lines.en: My stinger points at the altar, and misses.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草就不长。
lines.en: Where I pass, grass stops growing.

lines.zh: 细腿一步一响，还是往前走。
lines.en: Thin legs click each step, and still I go.
A joint clicks and I shift position.

lines.zh: 这条土路，尽头是一座矮坟。
lines.en: This dirt path ends at a low grave.

lines.zh: 回头看见的，是没埋好的骨头。
lines.en: Look back and you'll see bones half-buried.
A small rasp in my chest, like something crawling.

lines.zh: 安静得我听见幽匿在呼吸。
lines.en: So quiet I hear the sculk breathing.
By the seventh rib, I lose count.

lines.zh: 我的尾刺竖起来，尖端发蓝。
lines.en: My tail stinger rises, tip glowing blue.

lines.zh: 那盏火把，晃得我脊椎发紧。
lines.en: That torch makes my spine tighten.

lines.zh: 天亮，我照样钻回菌缝里。
lines.en: Daylight or not, I slip back into the sculk seams.

lines.zh: 尾刺一直举着，忘了为什么。
lines.en: My stinger's still raised and I forget why.

lines.zh: 要紧的事，大概和谁的血有关。
lines.en: Something important. Probably someone's blood.
This frame doesn't tire from standing.

lines.zh: 活着时我比这高半个头。
lines.en: Alive, I stood half a head taller.

lines.zh: 幽匿记得每个踩过它的人。
lines.en: Sculk remembers everyone who trod on it.

lines.zh: 我藏在幽匿块里，等你踩上。
lines.en: I hide in the sculk; step on me.

lines.zh: 你脚下这块土，是埋我的。
lines.en: The soil under you is the soil they buried me in.

lines.zh: 你眼里有光，借我一会儿。
lines.en: There's light in your eyes. Lend it a moment.

lines.zh: 他们叫我幽匿刺客，记住。
lines.en: They call me Sculk Stinger. Remember.

lines.zh: 再近半步，让我数你的骨头。
lines.en: Half a step closer. Let me count your bones.

lines.zh: 火别灭，灭了我就只剩刺。
lines.en: Keep the fire lit. Without it I'm only a stinger.
I won't move. The stinger won't either.
Your shadow is longer than your legs.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，你梦里见过吧。
lines.en: You've seen this face in a dream, haven't you.
One more hit and the stinger points at your feet.
Five points left, two more hits in me.
Ribs cracked. Still walking.

lines.zh: 我记住你了，幽匿也记住了。
lines.en: I remember you, and so does the sculk.
Sculk holds me together; one bump loosens it.
Even an assassin leaves fragments.

lines.zh: 听见没，我的肩又错位了。
lines.en: Hear that? My shoulder's out again.
Dirt flew. That was mean.

lines.zh: 手臂垂着，刺还举得起来。
lines.en: Arm hangs loose; the stinger still rises.
Stop. My stinger is trembling.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，熏得我刺痒。
lines.en: Your warmth makes my stinger itch.
The sculk stinger takes one lick first.
The sting on my tail carries just five health.

lines.zh: 生前的事，我只记得腐肉。
lines.en: Of my old life, I remember only carrion.

lines.zh: 给一口，我就跟到你的床边。
lines.en: One bite and I'll follow you to your bed.

lines.zh: 五个点的身子，饿起来没底。
lines.en: Five points of body, and hunger with no floor.

lines.zh: 幽匿不用吃饭，只用来感染。
lines.en: Sculk doesn't eat — it only infects.
This tail stinger seeks soft spots.
Don't speak. I already smell the cut.
That sculk fragment — I still want it.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨，被你碰得直响。
lines.en: You knocked my ribs into a rattle.
No sculk on you. You're alive.

lines.zh: 肩胛错开了，我自己按回去。
lines.en: My shoulder slipped; I pushed it back in.
A click, and my stinger snapped.

lines.zh: 我只有五点血，可我的刺不轻。
lines.en: Only five points of health, but my sting is no joke.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，尾刺就抬一寸。
lines.en: One bump and my stinger lifts an inch.
Five health, and one sting is all.
My tail stinger strikes true.

lines.zh: 我侧过身子，刺还朝着你。
lines.en: I step aside, stinger still aimed at you.

lines.zh: 退后，别贴这么近，刺会动。
lines.en: Back off; my stinger moves.

lines.zh: 胸腔空的，敲起来是闷响。
lines.en: My chest is hollow; it knocks dull.
My stinger is too thin to see.
One point of sting, that's all.

lines.zh: 埋了我的人，没教过这些。
lines.en: Whoever buried me never taught me this.

lines.zh: 两副骨架，站在同一片菌下。
lines.en: Two skeletons under the same patch of sculk.
Next life, I won't crawl into the soil.

lines.zh: 坟挖了一半，另一半给你。
lines.en: Half a grave dug. The other half for you.
My finger bones are too thin; rings slide off.
My stinger is longer than my nerve.
Do not speak of love, speak of remembering me.
I still recognize this thing.

lines.zh: 握在手里，比我的骨头轻。
lines.en: Lighter in my hand than my own bone.
Still warm. Dropped not long ago.
Three fingers. Grip it steady.
The joint's stuck; I have to force it.
Trade this for meat. One piece is plenty.
Bury it in the sculk seam, keep it for later.
Hook it on my stinger, tuck it away.
Whatever the soil gives up is mine.
Small enough to slip through cracks.

lines.zh: 别回头，尾巴已经到你脚边。
lines.en: Don't turn; my tail is at your feet.
Half the night searching. There you are.
I'm where you're not looking.
Hold still. My stinger's level.
Run. I'll count your steps.

lines.zh: 这地方，活人进来就出不去。
lines.en: The living don't walk out of here.
Before you move, look at my tail.
Five health, but I am quick.
One twitch of the tip and it's locked.
Five points of blood, and fast enough.
No rush. I'll follow your prints.

lines.zh: 幽匿里藏久了，你总会慢下来。
lines.en: Hidden in sculk this long — you'll slow down.
One sting. No need to struggle.
Hands to your ears. Stay still.
Leave the eyeballs. They stay with me.
A heartbeat that loud gives you away.

lines.zh: 让你等久了，我从缝里出来。
lines.en: Sorry to keep you. I'm out of the crack.

lines.zh: 幽匿里跑这么快做什么。
lines.en: Why run so fast through sculk?
Stop, let me draw my stinger back.
Five health, but quick.

lines.zh: 尾尖离你的脚踝只差半寸。
lines.en: The tip is half an inch from your ankle.

lines.zh: 你喘你的，我数着拍子追。
lines.en: Breathe. I'll chase to the rhythm.

lines.zh: 我不用追，你自己会踩空。
lines.en: I needn't chase; you'll step wrong yourself.

lines.zh: 你的影子拐弯，我也拐弯。
lines.en: Your shadow turns; so do I.

lines.zh: 追了这么久，腿都成骨了。
lines.en: Chased this long, my legs are bare bone.
In light my stinger stiffens.
This stinger breaks off inside you.

lines.zh: 这片菌毯，没有别的出口。
lines.en: This sculk mat has no other exit.
I've no lungs to tire with.
I know which soil is loose.
Break my legs and I crawl on my stinger.
The sculk magnifies your steps.

lines.zh: 慢点，我的刺快够到你了。
lines.en: Slow down. My stinger's nearly there.

lines.zh: 前头是断崖，我早看过了。
lines.en: It's a cliff ahead. I checked.

lines.zh: 你的脚后跟，已经麻了吧。
lines.en: Your heel's gone numb already, hasn't it.

lines.zh: 你的气味留在这条路上。
lines.en: Your scent stays on this path.
The faster you run, the stronger the blood smells.
That strike waited a long time.

lines.zh: 五点血的骨架子，还会扎人。
lines.en: Five points of bone, and it still stings.

lines.zh: 退了半步，刺尖就够着了。
lines.en: Half a step back and the tip reaches.
It's in. I can't pull it out.

lines.zh: 我只有五点血，一击必中。
lines.en: Five health — one hit, and it lands.
My stinger found the armor seam.
One spine is enough to numb you all night.

lines.zh: 关节一响，我已经在你侧面。
lines.en: A click, and I'm at your flank.

lines.zh: 五点的身子，也能扎出血。
lines.en: Five points of body can still draw blood.
Skin's cut. Missed the flesh by a hair.
One sting and the numbness spreads.
My stinger arrives before my body.

lines.zh: 刺出去的时候，我自己都吓一跳。
lines.en: Even I flinch when I strike.

lines.zh: 我只用一刺，不挥第二下。
lines.en: One sting is all I swing.
Numb, isn't it. Knees first.
Don't shift your feet. I'm aiming.
The sculk splits and my head comes out.
I seep out of a wall crack.
Thin legs, hold. Don't shake.

lines.zh: 这副骨架，又被挖出来了。
lines.en: This frame's been dug up again.
All three fingers answer.
Out of the mat, and already empty.
My stinger itches — where do I go?
Dark enough. My stinger can glow blue.

lines.zh: 土底下比地上还冷三分。
lines.en: Under the soil it's three degrees colder.
Who stepped on my grave?

lines.zh: 土硬了，我扒了很久才出来。
lines.en: The soil had set; it took me long to claw out.
Put the torch away. My stinger hates light.
Don't step here. The stinger's in the dirt.

lines.zh: 五点血的刺客，藏在你背后。
lines.en: A five-point assassin, right behind you.
Not so fast. There's grease in my joints.
Two bones broke. I counted to two.
Sculk swells with water. So heavy.
It blew half an arm off.

lines.zh: 箭从背后来的，真不体面。
lines.en: An arrow from behind. Rude.
Magic burned through my shell.

lines.zh: 幽匿的空腔里，回声都干了。
lines.en: In this sculk hollow, even echoes have dried.
The sky strikes me. The sculk watches.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我连刺都伸不出去。
lines.en: In the void I can't even extend my stinger.
